scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The theorem concerns a>=3 and n>2a; the n=2a fully-whiskered-star boundary is acknowledged as covered prior work. The homotopy statement is nonequivariant. Exhaustive finite checks corroborate, but do not prove, the infinite-family proof. Unindexed equivalent earlier literature remains possible; external independent review has not been performed.
title: A topological shattering transition in connected maximum-independent-set extremizers
